review_candidates.title: Sr. Creative Designer (Performance Marketing) - Static & Motion
review_candidates.description: Building the Future of Open Finance Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work. The team Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. Kraken's Consumer Creative & Design team owns end-to-end creative execution for Kraken Consumer and Krak. Our disciplines cover performance ad creative, static and 3D design, motion design, AI video creative and web design, turning growth strategy into creative that converts across paid, owned and organic surfaces. We work closely with Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Content & Social, Lifecycle and our regional leads, holding the line on brand and messaging quality on everything that ships. The opportunity As our Senior Performance Creative, you concept, produce and ship paid creative for Kraken Consumer and Krak. Paid static is the center of the role, but we're hiring a hybrid rather than a specialist: this means you also ideate and create performance video and treat gen AI as a core production method rather than a novelty. You take a project from idea to a finished, approved, multi-market asset set, and you bring a real feel for what people stop on, share and screenshot. You report to the Creative Lead, Consumer Creative & Design, who gives you direction, feedback and cover in reviews. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. Senior here means craft and automation leadership: you set the bar for paid static on the team, work with AI enabled processes, collaborate closely with other Krakenites in and outside the team, and are the person others come to with performance creative questions. Own paid static for Kraken Consumer across product launches, campaigns, promotions and always-on activity. Build for channels like Meta, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Reddit and X. You know what wins where, and you build to each platform's specs and native feel. Concept and cut performance video so campaigns ship as complete cross-format sets, from 9:16 sound-on to static-adjacent 1:1 and 4:5. Produce AI-generated and AI-assisted video and imagery, and know when AI is the fastest route to a great ad and when it isn't. Bring ideas to briefs rather than executing them literally. Pitch culturally timely, internet-native concepts that nobody asked for, and build the winners into creative pillars we can keep using. Version and localize at scale across markets, languages, formats and regulatory requirements. In a typical month you'll have roughly a dozen workstreams in flight at once, most spanning several formats and several markets. Build creative that's designed to be tested. Performance Marketing owns test design, cadence and readouts. You own the creative response: reading the results, forming a point of view on why a variant won, and turning that into the next round of hooks, concepts and cuts. Partner with Product Marketing, compliance and regional teams to get work approved without losing the idea. Hold a high craft bar on your own work and keep your files clean enough for other people to build on. What You’ll Bring 5+ years in performance creative at a high-volume in-house team or performance agency, ideally in fintech, crypto, gaming or another regulated category. A portfolio that proves it, submitted with your application. Paid static above all, with the brief or objective alongside the work and the result where you're able to share it. Include two or three full video cuts, at least one AI-generated or AI-assisted piece with a short note on what was tooling and what was you, and one concept you tested where you can talk us through what the data said and what you changed. Layout, hierarchy, type and composition that hold up at thumbnail size, in feed, and in multiple languages. Platform-native instincts across Meta, TikTok and YouTube. You can explain why the same idea needs a different build on each one. Real video skills, from concept to finished, sound-designed cut. High-level command of gen AI video and image tooling, with shipped work to show for it. Experience inside a structured creative testing program. You're fluent in the metrics your creative moves (thumb-stop rate, hook rate, CTR, CVR, CPA and ROAS), you can tell a real winner from low performers, and can translate test results into a creative decision. Fluency in internet and meme culture, with comedic timing and an instinct for what's about to feel dated. Speed without sloppiness. Comfortable with fast turnarounds, several review rounds and late changes. Comfort working inside regulatory constraints, with layouts that survive risk warnings and market-specific requirements. A solid copywriting instinct. Plain language, value first, no hype and no jargon. Figma and Adobe CC (After Effects, Premiere, Photoshop) as well as strong genAI skills Curious about investing and crypto at a minimum, and able to make the space legible to others. Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. Our commitment Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto. We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision. As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. review_candidates.description: The Position JOB DESCRIPTION The Social Protection Officer plays a central role in ensuring the successful implementation of the IPA 2022 “EU4PEOPLE-SOCIAL PROTECTION PROGRAMME in BiH. To Achieve This, You Will Manage the day-to-day operations of the program, ensuring alignment with the established requirements by UNICEF, UNDP, UNFPA and ILO. Ensure collaboration with the implementing partners to guarantee activities are delivered on time and within budget. The incumbent will report directly to the Assistant Representative How You Can Make a Difference UNFPA is the lead United Nations agency for delivering a world where every pregnancy is intended, every childbirth is safe, and every young person's potential is fulfilled. The UNFPA Strategic Plan for 2026-2029 articulates the organization’s response to a complex global environment, providing a roadmap for resilience and renewal. It is designed to accelerate the implementation of the Programme of Action of the International Conference on Population and Development (ICPD) and the achievement of the Sustainable Development Goals by 2030. This mandate is pursued through a focus on four interconnected outcomes: ending the unmet need for family planning; ending preventable maternal deaths; ending gender-based violence and harmful practices; and adapting to demographic change through evidence and rights-based policies. In a world where fundamental human rights are at risk, we need principled and ethical staff, who embody these international norms and standards, and who will defend them courageously and with full conviction. UNFPA is seeking candidates that transform, inspire and deliver high impact and sustained results; we need staff who are transparent, exceptional in how they manage the resources entrusted to them, and who commit to deliver excellence in programme results. Job Purpose Working within the Country Office (CO) environment, you will coordinate the implementation of “EU4PEOPLE - Social Protection Programme” for UNFPA, supporting the UNFPA components of the project, focused on social protection of vulnerable groups, demographic change and ageing and gender-responsive social services.. The Position Required Adequate Interaction Among Different Key Stakeholders UNICEF - United Nations Children's Fund, UNDP - United Nations Development Programme and ILO - International Labour Organization. Government stakeholders: The Ministry of Civil Affairs, Federal Ministry of Labor and Social Policy, The Ministry of Health and Social Policy of Republika Srpska, The Department of Social Policy at the Brčko District and other relevant institutions The Overall Objective Of The Action “EU4PEOPLE - Social Protection Programme” Aims To Improve Social Inclusion, Reduce Inequalities, And Advance Gender Equality Through a Modernized, EU-aligned Social Protection System That Delivers Quality, Rights-based Services To Those Most In Need. This Will Be Achieved Through Three Mutually Reinforcing Specific Objectives strengthening the institutional, professional, and digital capacities of Centers for Social Welfare (CSW) and social protection institutions; expanding and institutionalizing standardized, licensed, non-institutional and community-based social services; and strengthening inspection systems leading to improved compliance, monitoring, and quality assurance in line with International Labor Standards, (ILS) and EU acquis Led by UNICEF as the coordinating agency, and implemented in partnership with UNDP, UNFPA, and ILO, the Action brings together complementary mandates and expertise in social and child protection, governance and digital transformation, demographic resilience and gender equality, and decent work and labor inspection. Strong government ownership is ensured through close cooperation with state-, entity-, cantonal-, and Brčko District-level authorities, as well as municipal authorities, CSWs, and public and non-public service providers. The Social Protection Officer plays a vital role in keeping the Implementation on track by: Project implementation and support to management: Overseeing the day-to-day implementation and supporting the management of the project, working closely with UN agencies and other key partners, coordinating project activities, and leading the project team to ensure timely and effective delivery of results. Tracking progress: Monitoring research activities and making adjustments when needed to ensure progress. Building relationships: Working collaboratively with all partners, including government agencies, research institutions, and donors, to foster positive working relationships. You Would Be Responsible For Support to Project Coordination: Support the implementation of the UNFPA Component, ensuring alignment with project objectives, timelines, and effective collaboration with all stakeholders, implementing partners, government, and experts, in line with the agreed Work Plan. Support coordination among program staff, promoting a transformative and context-appropriate approach. Ensure timely execution of research activities through efficient planning, monitoring, and implementation, leveraging effective modalities and practices. Ensure timely communication with Administrative Agent and UNFPA Management on updates developments and reporting requirements for the Action. Coordinate evidence generation and analytical work on demographic change, ageing, disability, gender inequalities and care needs to inform evidence-based social protection reforms and service planning. Support the strengthening of the social protection system by integrating demographic resilience and gender-responsive approaches into local social protection policies, service standards, and delivery models, while building the capacities of social workers and service providers to better respond to the needs of older persons, persons with disabilities, and other vulnerable groups. Support the strengthening of quality assurance, oversight and compliance mechanisms for publicly funded women's shelters, including service standards, inspection protocols, safeguarding and survivor-centred approaches, in coordination with the EU GBV IPA project. Implementation & Quality Provide technical guidance to partners, ensuring adherence to standards and quality assurance mechanisms for data. Throughout the program, you support in tracking progress, monitoring how things are going, and make adjustments when needed to keep everything on track. This might involve anything from scheduling changes to reallocating resources. Oversight, Evaluation, and Reporting Establish a robust system to track partner progress, ensure adherence to project requirements, and proactively manage risks. Systematically evaluate partner effectiveness in achieving project objectives using qualitative and quantitative data, providing constructive feedback and recommendations for improvement. Prepare timely and accurate reports, contribute to research findings with actionable recommendations, and analyze the broader context to identify opportunities and policy implications for research implementation. Assisting in implementing knowledge management strategies to capture lessons learned and best practices, sharing these with management for future planning. Performs other duties as may be required and requested by the supervisor and agreed by CO’s management. Qualifications And Experience Education: An advanced degree (minimum Master's degree or equivalent) in, Social Sciences, Business Administration, Management or a related field. Knowledge And Experience Professional experience in project management, preferably in the field of public health, social policy and research would be considered highly advantageous. Proven experience in project management, including program design, coordination, monitoring, and evaluation, would be considered highly advantageous. Experience providing technical advice or similar support, along with donor reporting and capacity building, would be considered highly advantageous. Leadership skills in managing, researching and collaborating with diverse teams, including staff, experts, and consultants, would be considered highly advantageous.. Excellent communication, written reporting, and analytical skills. Experience working with the UN, international organizations, managing EU-funded projects, and multi-partner health research projects would be considered highly advantageous.. Experience using office software packages and web-based management systems. Languages Fluency in English and Bosnian/Croatian/Serbian is required Values Required Competencies: Exemplifying integrity, Demonstrating commitment to UNFPA and the UN system, Embracing cultural diversity, Embracing change Functional Competencies Advocacy/ Advancing a policy-oriented agenda Leveraging the resources of national governments and partners/ building strategic alliances and partnerships Delivering results-based programmes Internal and external communication and advocacy for results mobilisation Core Competencies Achieving results, Being accountable, Developing and applying professional expertise/business acumen, Thinking analytically and strategically, Working in teams/managing ourselves and our relationships, Communicating for impact

PhD project - Important the start date for this PhD is 1 st December 2026. PhD Position Topic: Enhancing Entanglement Quality in Quantum Networks We welcome applications for this Doctoral position whose goal is to expand, improve and evaluate our existing set of tools for improving the quality of entanglement between network nodes. Potential directions are improving techniques for entanglement distillation, potentially through a connection with error correction, and the use of discarding low-quality entanglement (cut-off time). We will use simulation and analytical calculation for doing so. As part of the Doctoral Network collaboration his position includes research stays of few months at: University of Naples Federico II (UNINA), Italy. EURECOM, France. In addition to these secondments, the position offers interdisciplinary training within the Doctoral Network. Research groups This project will be conducted within Tim Coopmans’ research group at QuTech, the quantum research institute of Delft University of Technology. The group focuses on the design of quantum networks and quantum circuits using techniques from (formal) computer science. You will work closely with this growing team, where most members, including the first PhD candidates who joined in September last year, are at a similar stage of their research journey. The current group has a mixed BSc/MSc background, ranging from computer science to physics, electrical engineering and mathematics. Here at QuTech, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse research environment, and we strongly encourage applications from women and candidates from underrepresented groups, including but not limited to those from diverse cultural, socioeconomic, and educational backgrounds. Also see the funding website: https://questing-project.eu/ TU Delft (Delft University of Technology) Delft University of Technology is built on strong foundations. As creators of the world-famous Dutch waterworks and pioneers in biotech, TU Delft is a top international university combining science, engineering and design. It delivers world class results in education, research and innovation to address challenges in the areas of energy, climate, mobility, health and digital society. We are developing scalable prototypes of a quantum computer and a secure quantum internet. We believe quantum technology will be a game changer in many social and economic sectors - including health, agriculture, climate, and security. To achieve our ambitious goals, we bring scientists, engineers, and industry together in an inspiring environment, with plenty of room for ambition, entrepreneurship, and innovation. Have a look at our video and get a glimpse of QuTech.
